'''The Crypt''' was a secret [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] and decoding center located in the lower levels of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Crypt also included a hangar used by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|period]]. It housed [[Palpatine's Sith Infiltrator]].
